keyEvents.text: Goal! Huddersfield Town 0, Exeter City 1. Jack Taylor (Exeter City) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Luca Woodhouse.
Goal! Huddersfield Town 1, Exeter City 1. Ibane Bowat (Huddersfield Town) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Cameron Humphreys following a corner.
Goal! Huddersfield Town 1, Exeter City 2. Charlie Cummins (Exeter City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Reece Cole.
